The following injectivement has its own long j descender. The cancellation crosses both but does not erase these distinguishing strokes. Only s'immerge versus s'envoie changes content; removal of doubt from injectivement is not a separate change.

changes.ink: Two small high ticks precede germe and two high ticks follow relèvement. They are quote strokes, with no paired angle-shaped guillemets. This follows the fixed convention requiring the two-backtick/two-apostrophe transcription of these handwritten marks.

changes.place: Diagram (9), relation between upper Gamma and lower Gamma prime
changes.ink: Between the two Gamma objects is a detached open-topped U/cup curve. It has no upward staff and no arrowhead. This differs visibly from the complete hooked upward arrow in diagram (10). Both actual arrows of (9), G-bar-X to Gamma and Gamma prime up-left to G-bar-X, have their heads.

changes.ink: Sur is followed by a blank interval and the joined double-s abbreviation. No separate un is written in that interval. The second subgroup phrase lower down does have a visible un, so the missing article here is not supplied from grammar.

changes.place: First subgroup abbreviation following sur
changes.ink: The abbreviation has two joined short upward/downward s strokes before a detached hyphen and the descending g of groupe. H contracts the source's two s forms to one.

changes.place: Second subgroup abbreviation following sur un
changes.ink: After the visible un there is again the joined double-s form, followed by groupe. Unlike the first occurrence there is no securely detached hyphen between this abbreviation and the g. C's ss groupe preserves the local form.

changes.place: Inline map after the inserted de xi
changes.ink: The horizontal stroke ends with a short, nearly vertical downward turn. It has no upper chevron arm and no completed rightward head. C's plain minus omits the small terminal; H supplies a full head. The final TeX draws the observed shaft and terminal directly. No mathematical interpretation as subtraction or a completed arrow is inferred.

changes.place: Prose transition after G-bar-X(xi)
changes.ink: De is written at the end of the formula line. The following line begins sorte, with a low s, rounded o and tall crossed t, then qu'on a un. The separated little strokes after the long q descender fit qu'on a; there is no trouve.

changes.place: First hom abbreviation, before composé
changes.ink: The h ascender and low om run finish before a blank interval leading into composé. No dark stop follows hom. The slight pale surface trace in the interval is not a punctuation dot.

changes.place: Word following the first hom abbreviation
changes.ink: The low com run is followed by a descending p and the compact osé ending. The separate short rising stroke at the upper right of the final e can be its acute. There is no tall t/b/l sequence of compatible. The same existing crop was reused once specifically to distinguish the acute from the last letter stroke.

changes.place: Upper live replacement map, codomain
changes.ink: The codomain's large letter has a rounded upper lobe, an oblique connecting stem and a curved open lower lobe, with X below right. It belongs to the curly E family and has none of the straight angular strokes of Sigma. This live map lies above and to the right of the cancelled copy.

changes.place: Lower cancelled map, codomain
changes.ink: Despite the crossing stroke, the lower codomain retains its rounded upper lobe and curled lower E lobe with a long trailing curve; X sits to its lower right. The lower map is cancelled across Gamma, shaft and codomain. Its large codomain letter is E, not Sigma.

changes.place: Diagram (10), leftmost object
changes.ink: The first object again has two rounded, open E lobes joined by an oblique stroke, and a separate X subscript. This agrees with both codomains of the revision pair, not with H's angular Sigma.

changes.place: Diagram (10), superscript on the diagonal arrow label
changes.ink: A distinct small t-shaped character stands at the upper right of the phi loop, with a short upright and transverse/angled head stroke. The multi-bend xi stands lower right. The superscript is separate ink, not a retracing of phi. C's preferred content is unchanged; its doubt resolution belongs to M0638. H omits t.

changes.place: Diagram (10), side of the diagonal arrow carrying its label
changes.ink: The complete phi label is visibly below the up-left diagonal, hanging well beneath its shaft. C's swapped quote label selects the opposite above/right side for this up-left arrow under the supplied TikZ-CD convention; no preamble override changes that. H's unswapped side is already below. Final TeX gives an explicit below option. The row concerns the actual label side, not merely different macro spelling.

changes.place: Closing paragraph, word after the second dash
changes.ink: The word begins with the small s/i formation and separate i dot, continues through the low n/o run and ends in n. There is neither an initial d loop nor the tall double-l sequence required for d'ailleurs.

changes.place: Closing paragraph, hom abbreviation
changes.ink: The h ascender and low om finish with a horizontal tail. The gap before defini contains no dark period. H adds a stop to this undotted abbreviation.

changes.place: Closing paragraph, defini and absent accent
changes.ink: The d/e connection leads into the tall continuous f stroke. No detached acute lies above the e; the rising stroke over that region is continuous with f. The existing ending_line crop was reused once for this concrete accent question. Both witnesses supply an acute that is not independently visible. Literal defini is retained with medium confidence after main-reader agreement.

changes.place: Closing paragraph, mod abbreviation
changes.ink: Mod is written as a low m, a separate small o stroke and an angular rising d. A blank interval separates d from composition; no stop follows it. H adds a period.

changes.place: Closing paragraph, uncertain autom abbreviation
changes.ink: The final short run on the upper line is compressed, with a raised t-like element and low terminal om-like continuation. Its exact letters remain insecure, but the visible run is a short form, not the full sequence automorphisme. H marks the full expanded two-word expression uncertain; that mark covers this first portion. C's uncertainty is retained.

changes.place: Closing paragraph, int. abbreviation at the start of the clipped lower line
changes.ink: At the lower-line opening, the visible short i/n/t run and terminal stop occupy only a few strokes before provenant. There is no full intérieur. Some lower tips meet the page edge, but the abbreviation extent is secure. H's one uncertainty wrapper spans the expansion intérieur as well as automorphisme.

changes.place: Clipped final word after pi_1(X).
changes.ink: A tall initial S is followed by a low ou run, a looped l, a dotted i region and a compressed gnons-like continuation. The lower portions touch the scan edge, so the full reading remains qualified. It is one continuous word, not a separate Scholie heading followed by a colon and another unreadable unit. H's ill placeholder is within this locally missegmented closing run.

marks.ink: The t is a distinct raised character at upper right of the phi, and xi has its separate lower multi-bend trace. The complete label hangs below the diagonal. H lacks the t. C's preferred reading is resolved, not replaced.
The short compressed final run plausibly reads autom, with a raised t-like stroke, but the intervening small letters cannot all be securely separated. Do not expand it to automorphisme.
The initial S, low ou, looped l and continuation favor Soulignons; the lower ink is clipped along the page edge, preventing a secure complete letter-by-letter resolution.

notes: Orientation is upright. The leaf visibly carries a light 2 at the upper right and a 3 at the lower left. Both manuscript numerals are transcribed and inventoried. Neither archive numbering nor H's editorial page note is counted as an omission.

The original was successfully inspected once for layout, then both supplied overlapping native halves once, all words, formulas, prime marks, accents, punctuation, revisions and diagram arrows against C and H, including their agreements. Eleven contextual crops were made, each from the exact original-pixel bounds in crop_boxes and enlarged once with LANCZOS to width 3000, autocontrast and UnsharpMask. Every saved crop was personally viewed. An earlier original-image tool result before the current successful view was truncated before an image appeared and is not claimed as an inspection.

Two existing crops, factorisation and ending_line, were each reused once for the concrete new accent questions composed/composé and defini/défini. No new image or recrop was made for these questions. The small upper-right rising stroke of composé is retained as its acute; the e of defini has no independently detached accent. Main reader inspected the original and all eleven crops and independently agreed with these decisions.

The entire upper passage, including its map, is cancelled. The large enclosing/bounding stroke and oblique cancellation strokes are represented by deletion state; they are not extra edges of a mathematical diagram. The independent dark J at the end of the map is distinguished from the much thinner adjacent cancellation enclosure. The underline of l'application is separately preserved.

Groupe in the top cancelled line is written in full. The apparent dark dot after the initial gr cluster does not end an abbreviation: low continuation, a downward p-like turn and the final short e follow it. The compressed groupe runs on the subgroup lines of this same page support that local reading. Both witnesses already have the full word, so there is no change row.

The long insertion xi in X(Q-bar) donné, et pour attaches after Pour; de xi sits over the next inline Gamma-prime map; germe d' sits above hom. All three additions are retained with insertion wrappers. The original map below hom composé is cancelled and the live replacement stands above and to its right. The final gathered display preserves that upper/lower offset; macro or line-wrap differences alone are not counted.

The inline shaft is deliberately not regularised to a full right arrow or interpreted as subtraction. Its horizontal body and very short downward end are directly drawn in the TeX. C's missing terminal and H's added full arrowhead are the local graphic differences in D12, with no mathematical consequence asserted.

Both live diagrams were checked object by object and at both ends of each arrow. Diagram (9) has two actual arrows and a detached upright cup, not a third headed arrow. Diagram (10) has four actual arrows, including the genuinely hooked upward arrow, and the diagonal label phi_xi^t below its shaft. The C label-side row refers to the rendered swapped side for the up-left arrow, not merely quotation syntax. Final code explicitly requests below.

Three detached mark groups in diagram (10) were evaluated and excluded under the fixed speck rule: a short dark fragment left-above E, an isolated dot above the first horizontal arrow, and two tiny oblique points at the upper-left of phi. They have no secure syntactic or diagrammatic attachment. They are treated as pen/surface specks, not invented punctuation, labels or uncertainty graphics. Main reader independently agreed.

H supplies actual local TikZ-CD code for both diagrams on this page; those arrows, objects and labels were compared directly. X versus H's mathfrak X and bold Q versus H's blackboard Q are treated as font renderings of the same handwritten letter/field, not independently established different symbols. H's literal Sigma is different from the visibly curly E and does receive three separate local rows.

The final line is physically close to/clipped by the scan edge. Int. and provenant de pi_1(X). remain sufficiently readable; autom and Soulignons remain marked in place. H's expanded automorphisme intérieur and its Scholie : ill segmentation are not silently adopted. The visible source has one continuing final word, not an independently supported heading followed by another unreadable phrase.

No proof, computation, independent re-proof, or substantive mathematical validity check was performed. The existence of a germ of lifting, its factorisation and the final statement about inner automorphisms were transcribed rather than verified. check_events is therefore empty. No additional mathematical tension was established from this leaf alone; the source's incomplete arrow shape is preserved without mathematical repair.

C's preferred phi_xi^t is resolved at M0638 without a C content-change row. The separate H omission of t and C placement difference are still genuine local differences. Retaining autom and Soulignons is an undecided mark decision, not a resolution. C's uncatalogued opening uncertainty is handled by the actual first-word correction D01, without inventing a MARKS identifier.
